author.method: Full visual reading of all 8 complete original-PDF pages and retained same-source detail crops. No website VI read or comparison.

pageObservations.observation: Whole title, four goals, labels and warmup instruction match the original. Goal includes hàng hoá; RMB objective Nhận biết được đồng Nhân dân tệ is whole. Warmup options only Chinese/pinyin; no fabricated Vietnamese. This page was actually viewed as previous lesson boundary and all nine current records compared.

All five whole ZH/VI dialogue turns and correct speaker Nhân viên bán hàng match. Seven word rows/pinyin/raw POS match; money 块 lượng. đồng (đơn vị tiền tệ) is preserved faithfully. All headings/scene/read/role/pair instructions and the two physical lines in fourth role match.

Full three-line money explanation explicitly identifies Trung Quốc / RMB and unit order; arrow and mixed Chinese tokens retained. Three parenthesized Vietnamese table headers match; six table body rows have no Vietnamese. Text2 scene/listen instruction and book header complete; no omitted printed Vietnamse.

Five full dialogue turns, six word rows8–13 with raw POS/pinyin, and whole shopping-role practice instructions match. The source actually uses Người bán hàng here rather than first-text Nhân viên bán hàng; retain the printed variation. Price uses decimal comma7,2 and cân, and 斤 gloss explicitly defines Chinese unit0,5kg. Scene lies on88, all speakers/turns on89.

Complete two-line adjective-predicate grammar explanation, title/read instruction and text3 scene/listen instruction match. The whole scene identifies Lưu Minh and Vương Nhất Tuyết buying clothes for children; no Chinese-only example/listening choices mislabelled as printed Vietnamese.

Six full dialogue turns and 10 word rows14–23/rawPOS/pinyin match. Tiểu Tuyết vs Tiểu Minh and female/male clothes are correctly associated. Three-line full fifth translation retained; proper names in dialogue are not fabricated proper-name word rows. Both translated reading questions and instructions match.

Full question-word explanation and physical two-line wrap match. Vietnamese tình hình... uses three baseline dots, while following Chinese ……怎么样? displays six midline dots represented as two U+2026. This explicit character policy is preserved. All grammar/exercise headings and instructions correct; examples and fill-blank stems have no Vietnamese printed.

All whole printed Vietnamese picture instruction, classroom role-play instructions, closing video heading Món quà của Tiểu Ngữ and title Nhận biết về đồng Nhân dân tệ match. Four picture stems are Chinese only. Two-line three-person instruction complete; chapter ends here.

Whole original boundary page actually viewed: Bài 11 / 我读大学呢 / Em đang học đại học starts the next lesson. The page is excluded from all121 accepted lesson10 source occurrences. Earlier reviewer note mistakenly named another lesson; this correction changes the boundary description only.

decisions.verifiedVietnamese: Đơn vị tiền tệ của Trung Quốc được gọi là Nhân dân tệ (RMB). Các đơn vị của Nhân dân tệ xếp từ lớn đến nhỏ là “元”, “角” và “分”, trong văn nói lần lượt được gọi là “块”, “毛” và “分”. Trật tự diễn đạt là: 元/块 → 角/毛 → 分.
decisions.verifiedChineseContext: 中国的货币叫人民币。人民币的单位由大到小是“元、角、分”，口语中也分别说“块、毛、分”。表达顺序是：元/块→角/毛→分。
